description: v1 draft. From the review-log 2026-10-02 transcription of Professor Elias's inline sheet (v1-v4: the image was not in the repo, so the v1 values were transcribed, not sampled): the six palette chips navy / dark brown / taupe / cream / gold / teal as named, plus the transcribed colours (grey hair + beard, blue cravat, cream robe, dark brown trousers, brown boots + belt + satchel, dark bracers, navy gold-trimmed mantle, brass armillary, teal orb + brooch gem, dark tome). Skin is a warm placeholder until the sheet can be sampled. Glow: the teal crystal only (staff orb + brooch gem), subtle. v5: skin, eyes and the hair + beard greys PIXEL-SAMPLED from design/reference/elias/elias_sheet.webp (1536x1024; head panel x1056-1298 y52-335 + the three figures' heads; masked luminance-percentile BAND medians, see each note); values not on the sheet are marked 'derived'. Palette chips sampled (13x13 medians at y=926): navy #42404c, dark brown #60483e, taupe #836f5f, cream #ccb395, gold #c2965f, teal #4d8280 -- recorded only (the outfit regions are outside the v5 scalp lane).

skin.note: v5 SAMPLED #c2946f: lit cheek / forehead / nose (head panel, hue 8-40 deg / sat > 0.22 pixels, the 80-90th luminance pct band median; v1 placeholder [214, 164, 128])

skin_shadow.note: v5 SAMPLED #967359: the same face pixels' 10-20th pct band (authored jaw / neck cast shadow)

lips.note: v5 derived: a step paler + less saturated than skin (v1's offset +2 / +6 / +12 kept)

mouth.note: v5 derived: the one mouth line = skin x v1's mouth / skin ratio

liner.note: v5 derived: thin lower lid line = skin x v1's ratio

lash.note: v5 SAMPLED #392519: the upper lid line pixels over the near eye (value < 0.30)

brow.note: v5 SAMPLED #5f483c: the heavy brows (head panel brow box, value < 0.45) -- darker than the hair, as on the sheet

face_line.note: v5 derived: painted age lines = skin x v1's ratio (a soft step darker)

beard_inner.note: v5 derived (v4 rule): the zone under the beard shell = hair_beard_root -> skin 0.15 (sRGB lerp), so the thin strip at the shell's sunk edge continues the fade

beard_fade1.note: v5 derived (v4 rule): stubble fade step 1 = hair_beard_root -> skin 0.35

beard_fade2.note: v5 derived (v4 rule): stubble fade step 2 = hair_beard_root -> skin 0.60

beard_fade3.note: v5 derived (v4 rule): stubble fade step 3 (outermost, serrated) = hair_beard_root -> skin 0.82

eye_sclera.note: derived (not sampled: the sheet shows the sclera only in lid shadow, #b49781)

eye_iris.note: v5 SAMPLED #5e5045: iris pixels of both eyes (sat < 0.32, value < 0.42), the 70-95th pct band -- warm dark grey-brown (v1 placeholder: blue-grey [92, 122, 140])

eye_iris_dark.note: v5 SAMPLED #342f29: the same iris pixels' 5-30th pct band (the lid-shadow band)

hair.note: v5 SAMPLED #9a8371: scalp hair, 11.9k low-saturation pixels off the head panel + front / side / back figures, 40-60th pct band (the warm taupe grey of the sheet = the taupe chip family #836f5f)

hair_shade.note: v5 SAMPLED #7e6a5d: the hair's 8-20th pct band (the drawn under-strands): lock undersides

hair_root.note: v5 SAMPLED #8b7667: the hair's 20-35th pct band: painted root tier

hair_ring.note: v5 SAMPLED #baa189: the hair's 85-92nd pct band: angel ring (the 92-99th band #cfbd9e, the drawn highlight strokes, printed as bright patches across the wide locks: measured on the first v5 build)

hair_tip.note: v5 SAMPLED #ae957e: the hair's 70-82nd pct band: lighter tips

hair_inner.note: v5 derived: the DARK inner cap = hair x 0.55 (Wren's inner / hair ratio)

hair_crevice.note: v5 derived: tuck shade under the lock above = hair x 0.62 (Wren's ratio)

hair_beard.note: v5 SAMPLED #ae9683: the beard (head panel beard box, sat < 0.25 / value > 0.45 pixels, 40-60th pct band) -- lighter than the scalp hair, as on the sheet; own region = the beard-tone knob

hair_beard_shade.note: v5 derived: shell underside = hair_beard x 0.69 (v4's shade / body ratio)

hair_beard_root.note: v5 SAMPLED #8f7e6e: the beard's 8-20th pct band: the shell's root tier (the top edge, into the fade)

hair_beard_tip.note: v5 SAMPLED #b69e8a: the beard's 75-90th pct band: lighter lobe tips

hair_beard_crevice.note: v5 derived: lobe-join groove lines = hair_beard x 0.806 (v4's measured soft step: 150 / 186)

robe_roll.note: the big rolled sleeves, a touch lighter (fold highlight)

brass.note: gold / brass: buckle, brooch, crest, motifs, armillary, ferrule, clasp (chip: gold)

brass_dark.note: brass grooves, the brooch's raised crest

scroll_paper.note: parchment scrolls poking out of the satchel

crystal.note: TEAL: the staff orb + the brooch gem (chip: teal); the only glow, subtle

glasses.note: round wire glasses (gold wire; the frame colour is an artist question)

capelet.note: capelet: the mantle navy a hair lighter (layer separation)

material.note: the house shaded material: Col x baked AO, baked normal map; no cel bands, no outline shells
